title: 第20章 此人值得深交第21章 生死战生死各安天命
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 很是愤怒。
冰冷的眼神盯著面前青年，被一个初级班的学员出手抢夺积分，不愤怒才怪。
楚阳笑了。
“阁下未免太猖狂了，你认为自己能够以一敌三？”
够狂！
楚阳和叶飞却很清楚，一个来自初级班的学员，没有十足的底气，肯定不会贸贸然地出手，毕竟出手抢夺中级班学员的积分，稍有不慎，就会落个偷鸡不成蚀把米的下场。
选择交出积分，肯定是不可能的事情。
积分，是潜龙爭夺战的根本，要是连自己手里的积分都保不住，谈何去爭夺其他人的积分。
除此之外。
最重要的还是顏面问题，要是自己三人被初级班学员抢夺积分，此事传回学院，他们三人肯定会成为整个学院的笑柄。
苏辰笑著说道：“三位，我不想出手，希望三位能够乖乖交出积分。”
白璃彻底怒了，怒道：“休得猖狂，我倒要看看，你一人如何击败我们三人联手。”
此战绝对不能败。
输不起！
三人同时释放出各自的血轮，全部散发著强大的气息，三人的脸色都很是难看。
率先出手。
三人宛如一头头猎豹，直接朝著属於自己的猎物飞奔而去，他们要做的事情就是击败此人，並且抢夺此人手里的积分，告诉此人囂张会有什么样的后果。
人未到，血轮的恐怖气势已经层层叠加席捲而来，犹如苍天猎鹰扑向地面的小白兔，无尽怒火滚滚笼罩。
没有丝毫的大意和轻视，他们能够感受得出来，此人脸上流露出的那种信心。
没有绝对的信心，肯定不敢挑衅他们。
血轮凝聚，一柄蕴含著杀戮的剑虚影，静静地漂浮在血轮之內，剑吟嘶吼，伴隨著霸道剑气纵横。
苏辰的身影突然消失在原地，只留下道道残影，三人的强悍攻势扑了个空，不过三人也算是反应迅速。
看著突然消失的身影，立刻锁定残影闪现的方向，再次朝著苏辰狠狠地轰击而去。
『好快的速度』
『速战速决』
三人心里很是惊讶，似乎没有想到，苏辰拥有如此快的速度，甚至留下道道残影。
犹如鬼魅般，苏辰的身影瞬间出现在白璃身后。
“白学妹，小心。”
“已经晚了。”
苏辰的声音很是冰冷，以指代剑，冰冷剑气顺势而出，並未下死手，毕竟这里是东荒学院，已经明確规定，潜龙爭夺战不允许出现任何死亡。
他不会去挑战学院的底线。
剑气停留在白璃的脑后，一个指甲盖的距离，只要苏辰愿意，隨时隨地都可以击杀白璃。
content_en:
Very angry.
He stared at the young man in front of him with cold eyes. It would be strange not to be angry when a junior class student snatched his points.
Chu Yang smiled.
"Your Excellency is too arrogant. Do you think you can fight one against three?"
Crazy enough!
However, Chu Yang and Ye Fei knew very well that a student from the junior class would not act rashly if he did not have full confidence. After all, if he were to steal the points from the students in the intermediate class, he would end up losing everything if he was not careful.
It is definitely impossible to choose to hand over points.
Points are the basis of Qianlong's battle. If you can't even keep the points in your own hand, how can you compete for other people's points?
besides.
The most important thing is the issue of face. If the three of them are robbed of points by junior class students and this matter is reported back to the academy, the three of them will definitely become the laughing stock of the entire academy.
Su Chen smiled and said: "Three of you, I don't want to take action. I hope that the three of you can obediently hand over your points."
Bai Li was completely angry and said angrily: "Don't be so arrogant, I want to see how you can defeat the three of us together."
This battle cannot be lost.
Can't afford to lose!
The three of them released their blood chakras at the same time, all exuding powerful auras, and their faces were all ugly.
Take the lead.
The three of them were like cheetahs, flying directly towards their prey. What they had to do was to defeat this person, snatch the points from this person's hand, and tell this person what the consequences would be if he was arrogant.
Before anyone arrived, the terrifying aura of the blood wheel was already sweeping over layer by layer, like a falcon in the sky pounced on the little white rabbit on the ground, endless anger rolling over it.
There was no carelessness or contempt at all, and they could feel the confidence on this person's face.
Without absolute confidence, we would certainly not dare to provoke them.
The blood wheel condensed, and the shadow of a sword containing killing floated quietly in the blood wheel. The sword roared, accompanied by the domineering sword energy.
Su Chen's figure suddenly disappeared on the spot, leaving only afterimages. The powerful offensive of the three people was in vain, but the three people responded quickly.
Looking at the figure that suddenly disappeared, he immediately locked the direction of the afterimage and struck hard at Su Chen again.
"So fast"
"Quick victory"
The three of them were very surprised. They didn't seem to have expected that Su Chen had such a fast speed and even left afterimages.
Like a ghost, Su Chen's figure instantly appeared behind Bai Li.
"Senior Sister Bai, be careful."
"It's too late."
Su Chen's voice was very cold, referring to the sword, and the cold sword energy came out without any fatal blow. After all, this is Donghuang Academy, and it has been clearly stipulated that no deaths are allowed in the battle for the hidden dragon.
He will not challenge the bottom line of the academy.
The sword energy stayed behind Bai Li's head, a fingernail's distance away. As long as Su Chen wanted to, he could kill Bai Li anytime and anywhere.
